messages:
sara: Quick request — can we run a full intake-slate compatibility playthrough for the new llama-q4f variant before we flip it in the registry? want to exercise bench, smoke probes, and the fallback routing path.
anna: +1. Do we have a succinct checklist? I want something we can hand to SRE runbook.
raj: Minimal checklist: 1) ingest artifact signature 2) bench smoke (30 samples) 3) golden prompts parity check 4) kv-cache sanity 5) fallback routing verification.
leo: Also add: metric drift alert test (simulate token distribution shift) and an inference-failover timing check.
sara: good. For bench smoke, can we reuse the slate sample set? it's smaller than the full golden set.
raj: yes — slate-samples-v2 is fine. Use --samples 30 --seed 42.
mika: heads-up: running bench on dedicated infra will need a short maintenance window unless you use the small-gpu queue. recommend small-gpu for speed and no impact.
anna: we'll run on small-gpu. who will start? @raj or @leo?
leo: I can kick off the run in ~10m. posting the command:
```
./bench-run --model=llama-q4f --sample-set=slate-samples-v2 --samples=30 --seed=42 --kv-check --emit-metrics
```
raj: nice. add --fallback-sim to validate routing policies (ensures canary -> fallback).
leo: adding it. will collect logs and metrics and paste summary here.
oncall-bot: CI: bench harness container image built (sha: c3f4ab2) — ready to run.
sara: ok starting playthrough now. tagging @mika for infra watch.
(10m later)
leo: run finished. quick highlights: 1) ingest signature verified 2) bench latency median +5% vs q4_0 baseline (expected) 3) golden prompt BLEU-style similarity 0.93 4) kv-cache misses spike on very long prompts 5) fallback sim passed (switch to smaller model in 210ms). attaching raw logs snippet below.
```
[bench] sample=1 latency=12ms tokens=45 kv_cache_hit=true
[bench] sample=30 latency=48ms tokens=512 kv_cache_hit=false
[fallback] triggered -> small-model v2 at 210ms
```
raj: kv-cache misses concern me. does ingest transform preserve prefix tokens? maybe tokenization change with quantization?
anna: I noticed we weren't running the tokenizer regression in preflight. add tokenization checksum to the ingress checks?
sara: agreed. new step: compute token-checksum on ingest and compare to golden-token-hash. If mismatch, block admit.
mika: infra note: enabling token-checksum will add ~0.4s per artifact but it's cheap vs rollout risk.
leo: i can update the preflight hook. quick patch:
```
# preflight hook pseudo
tokens = tokenize(model.readme_examples)
hash = sha256(tokens)
if hash != registered_hash: fail("token checksum mismatch")
```
raj: Also propose we include a tiny synthetic long-prompt probe (length ~1200 tokens) in slate-samples to catch kv-cache blowups earlier.
sara: yes add synthetic-long to slate-samples-v2 and re-run a short sweep before admit.
anna: rollout policy: if latency delta > 8% or kv miss rate > 4% on smoke, auto-fail canary. Fine?
leo: fine. i'll codify thresholds in the admit config and push a PR.
raj: one more thought — surface the fallback timing in the console per model version. makes oncall decisions faster.
mika: can double-check telemetry schema. shouldn't be hard.
sara: perfect. action items: leo update preflight/token-checksum + add synthetic-long to slate-samples, anna update admit thresholds in config, raj add fallback timing telemetry patch, mika enable infra watch mode for canary flips. We'll re-run the playthrough after patches. thanks all :thumbsup:
